obernants.approximation_semantics: Mathematical target with bounded finite evidence, not a proof.
obernants.assumptions: Ordinary Rust execution, sufficient allocation, byte equality.
obernants.domain: Deterministic test executions over the explicitly enumerated finite byte fixtures.
obernants.operator: Within the universe of these test runs paired with pass/fail observations, pass is excluded if any specified assertion is false. Fail is excluded when every assertion completes true in the ordinary execution model. Untested inputs and compiler/runtime defects remain outside the observation.

obernants.approximation_semantics: Mathematical target with bounded finite evidence, not a proof.
obernants.assumptions: Ordinary Rust execution, sufficient allocation, byte equality.
obernants.domain: Deterministic test executions over the explicitly enumerated finite byte fixtures.
obernants.operator: A passing observation admits every candidate implementation agreeing with all checked fixture observations; it cannot identify the source or constrain all untested inputs. A failing observation admits executions with at least one violated assertion; the assertion trace narrows the compatible implementations.

obernants.approximation_semantics: Mathematical target with bounded finite evidence, not a proof.
obernants.assumptions: Ordinary Rust execution, sufficient allocation, byte equality.
obernants.domain: Deterministic test executions over the explicitly enumerated finite byte fixtures.
obernants.operator: Fixture-preserving injective byte relabeling should preserve tested output; long constant fixtures exercise maximal radii.

obernants.approximation_semantics: Exact mathematical target under assumptions; bounded executed evidence only.
obernants.assumptions: Ordinary successful Rust execution, sufficient allocation and exact byte equality. Mathematical sums; test sums fit usize. Finite fixtures do not establish unrestricted correctness.
obernants.domain: Candidate vectors on named fixtures with at most 256 positions.
obernants.falsifiable_check: Run equality_constraints_reconstruct_and_reject or joint_parity_constraints_reconstruct_and_reject; reject in-bounds contradictory vectors.
obernants.observation_scope: Named relations and bounded source correspondence fixtures.
obernants.operator: Reconstruction succeeds iff bounds hold and no required inequality lies inside an equality class; returned witnesses must reproduce the candidate through production. Joint constraints, not individual bounds, determine feasibility.

obernants.approximation_semantics: Exact mathematical target under assumptions; bounded executed evidence only.
obernants.assumptions: Ordinary successful Rust execution, sufficient allocation and exact byte equality. Mathematical sums; test sums fit usize. Finite fixtures do not establish unrestricted correctness.
obernants.domain: Named distinct-output fixture pairs and deterministic projection assertions.
obernants.falsifiable_check: Run compressed_observation_and_collapsing_symbols or interval_membership_count_and_lossy_projection; full-vector equality is a rejected alternative.
obernants.observation_scope: Named relations and bounded source correspondence fixtures.
obernants.operator: Projection equality admits distinct full vectors: the sum observation cannot identify its antecedent. Passing interval/position assertions additionally constrains production at every named interval/threshold.
